title: STS2 Tracker v1.3.3 - High-Resolution Run Infographic Card Export
changelog: High-Res 16:9 Run Infographic Card: Instant 1920x1080 visual showcase of your run, complete decklist, relics, route pathing, and telemetry
Streamlined 1-Click Export: Clean 2-action modal with instant 'Download PNG' and 'Copy Image' to clipboard
Zero Rendering Errors: Fixed canvas color parsing and asset reference bugs across all characters (Defect, Regent, Ironclad, Silent, Necrobinder)
Clean, Polished UI: Simplified export presentation without extraneous buttons or third-party platform branding
notes: Introduces high-resolution 16:9 run infographic card export, 1-click clipboard image copy, and unified export controls.
